training_selection: Highest internal held-source macro nDCG, each source within2points of initialization; step0 eligible. No external development labels select a checkpoint within an arm.
data_comparison: Four arms, two precisions x broad versus repeated old data. Same pair presentations and initialization within precision. Source proportions and token lengths differ; no isolated novelty or equal-FLOPs claim.
conditional_reserved_gate: One candidate must exceed both pinned reference point estimates on each of the four observed retrieval tasks, STSBenchmark and the fixed12-task mean.
candidate_selection: Among candidates passing every gate, select highest equal-task mean across the four observed retrieval datasets. Ties resolve by lower artifact SHA256. Freeze physical file and report hashes before opening any new qrels.
confirmation: One frozen candidate and pinned references only; common128token cap, full corpora, no query instructions. Touche query1 excluded due pre-score preview exposure. No further training or selection after reserved scoring.
uncertainty: Paired per-query bootstrap5000samples, seed20261025; no claim of training-seed or arbitrary-domain uncertainty. No full-MTEB superiority claim.
paid_spending_approval: Approved up to $10 for this one four-arm job. Previous $10 campaign closed at $9.5843. Resource and all training/evaluation gates unchanged.

reserved_preview_exposure.mechanism: Web search result preview exposed several score0 document judgments for query1; no full qrels file fetched and no candidate scored on new reserved tasks.
reserved_preview_exposure.remedy: Exclude query1 completely from reserved confirmation. Corpus exclusions and all four paid training recipes remain unchanged. Remaining Touche query judgments and all TREC-COVID judgments stay reserved.

reserved_qrels_opened_definition: Full qrels files; preview exposure is explicitly recorded above.
